description: This file defines the PartialEmployee class within the OrangeHRM LDAP DTO namespace. It is a data transfer object (DTO) for partially representing an employee with minimal fields such as employee ID and work email, and includes methods for setting and retrieving these fields, as well as creating an instance from an Employee entity.

classes.name: PartialEmployee
classes.description: A DTO class representing a partial employee with minimal identifying information, used for LDAP integration and data transfer within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: createFromEmployee
methods.description: Creates a PartialEmployee instance from an Employee entity, copying the employee ID and work email.
